description: Standard or schema version used to structure the battery passport.
notes: 工程扩展项，保留标准/Schema版本含义，不等同contentSpecificationIds。

description: Unique identifier of the facility where the battery was manufactured.
notes: 按工厂唯一标识符的工程含义描述，不将其伪称官方1.0.0独立字段。

description: Separate-collection marking and applicable cadmium or lead symbols displayed on the battery.
notes: 本行D为镉铅标识、E为分类收集、枚举为组合图标；按现有组合业务项解释两类官方语义，不把它强改成一个boolean字段。

description: Electrochemical composition identifying the battery's chemistry.
notes: 使用简洁化学体系表述，不新增电解质披露范围约束。

description: Share of lead recovered from waste and present in the battery.
notes: 回收铅比例为工程保留项；不将铅比例限定为只在活性材料内统计。

description: Instructions for safely removing the battery pack from the equipment.
notes: 本行按电池拆除手册描述，与83行电池包内部拆解手册区分；未改变源表字段。

description: Initial ratio of net discharge energy to energy required to restore the initial state of charge.
notes: 保留官方定义中的net discharge energy，避免将放电总能量直接当净能量。

description: Decrease in round-trip energy efficiency over time and use, expressed as a percentage.
notes: 仅描述效率衰减，不自行指定相对值或百分点计算公式。

description: Expected battery lifetime in charge-discharge cycles under its design reference conditions.
Cumulative time above the upper boundary of the battery's specified idle temperature range.
Cumulative time below the lower boundary of the battery's specified idle temperature range.
Cumulative charging time above the upper boundary of the specified idle temperature range.
Cumulative charging time below the lower boundary of the specified idle temperature range.
